name: Frankenstein Walk
steps: Stand tall in an open lane with your arms extended straight out in front of you at shoulder height.
Step forward onto one leg and swing your opposite straight leg smoothly upward toward your outstretched hands with toes flexed.
Lower the kicking leg under control to step forward without letting your lower back round.
Continue alternating smooth straight-leg kicks down the lane for the target duration.
tips: Keep your torso upright and kick only as high as your hamstrings allow without rounding your spine.
Stay tall on your standing leg and swing smoothly rather than snapping your leg violently upward.
